answers.reason: The senate is a central body of the whole university.
The budget planning round is a central leadership or administrative concern.
Professors are part of academic appointments, but the text states members only take part in one specific place.
The faculty council decides on faculty affairs, but the junior professor has their own specific place.
The study commission prepares degree programmes outside the junior professor's assigned place.
Examination matters are handled separately from professorial duties.
Research funding is a separate body from teaching and professorship duties.
Module revisions are handled by a specific working group.
Laboratory equipment procurement is handled by a dedicated group.
Orientation week planning is a separate administrative task.
